fields.label: Rate
fields.description: The usual rate in this structure, copied onto an assignment when the allowance is picked there. Blank when it differs for every person (Dearness). Change an existing rate with a Salary Revision, so the people already paid it move too.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: From the allowance's kind: per month, per day present, per meal, % of initial basic, or worked out from basic.
